newsitem.title: USA: Fluor sees Q2 loss of $0.83/shr.
newsitem.headline: Fluor sees Q2 loss of $0.83/shr.

text.p: Fluor Corp said Tuesday it expects to report a loss for the second quarter ending in April of about $70 million, or $0.83 a share.

Fluor said its Fluor Daniel unit is expected to report a second quarter operating loss of about $110 million including provisions for project overruns and for implementation of cost reduction programs.
Fluor will report second quarter results on May 21.
The company said it has completed its previously announced evaluation of recorded provisions for cost overruns on two Fluor Daniel fixed price power projects.

The company said that the evaluation concluded that second quarter results will include a charge of about $120 million for the cost overruns. The company will also take a charge of about $20 million for implementing cost reduction programs.

In March, the company said that it would reduce costs in its Fluor Daniel operations by more than $100 million through closing or consolidating operations. Additional actions will be taken later in the year with any charges against earnings not expected to exceed $15 million.
Fluor said it expects Fluor Daniel will generate more than $140 million in operating profits in the second half.
"Given our revised strategy, we no longer believe it is prudent to pursue the goal of accelerating our earnings growth rate to a level approaching 20 percent," said Chairman Les McCraw.

"Earnings from continuing operations have grown on average more than 15 percent annually for the past nine years," he said. "The company will continue to focus on achieving an earnings growth goal that consistently places us in the top quartile of the S&P 500."
